security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: asset:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop client for a MiniDrive NAS
bundle.longDescription: Browse, transfer and sync files with a MiniDrive server. The bundled MiniDrive client does every protocol, TLS and end-to-end encryption step; this app is a view over it.
